Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

Key Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Design Vision
Define and own the design vision and product strategy for our payment products, balancing business goals, user needs, and compliance requirements.
Build and prioritize a roadmap of design and product improvements, using structured frameworks (e.g., RICE, ICE) to weigh impact against effort.
Establish UX/UI design best practices and design-quality standards across the org.
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of product designers and UX researchers.
Product Management for Design
Act as a de facto product manager for your area: translate research and data into structured feature proposals, PRDs, or specs that engineering and stakeholders can act on.
Proactively identify, pitch, and champion new features and improvements based on your own use of the app, competitive analysis, and user feedback. This role is expected to originate ideas, not just execute assigned tasks.
Define success metrics and KPIs for design and product initiatives (e.g., activation, feature adoption, NPS, task completion, retention) and report on outcomes.
Run experiments (A/B tests, usability benchmarks) to validate design and product decisions, using analytics tools (e.g., Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA).
Own the backlog and prioritization conversations jointly with product management and engineering leads.
User-Centered Design Execution
Drive end-to-end product design from discovery, journey mapping, and prototyping to detailed UI specifications.
Conduct and apply user research, usability testing, and data-driven insights to improve product flows and reduce friction.
Create and maintain design systems and patterns for consistency across channels (app, web).
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner with product managers and engineers to define product requirements and technical feasibility.
Work closely with risk, compliance, and legal teams to ensure designs adhere to regulatory standards (e.g., BSP, AML, KYC).
Collaborate with marketing and CX to ensure brand-consistent experiences.
Innovation & Market Trends
Stay ahead of payment UX trends in PH, SEA, and globally (e.g., tap-to-pay, open finance, e-wallet interoperability).
Explore opportunities to integrate emerging technologies such as QR Ph, NFC, merchant payment solutions, and blockchain into the payment journey.
Regularly use the Coins app as a customer would, and bring a running list of observations and improvement ideas to the team.


What We Expect From You
•

Bachelor's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, or a related field.

•

5+ years of experience in product design or a hybrid product design/product management role, with at least 2 years in a leadership or people-management capacity.

•

Demonstrated experience owning a product roadmap end-to-end prioritization, spec writing, success metrics, and post-launch measurement, not only visual/UX design execution.

•

Proven track record designing scalable payment systems, e-wallets, or financial services platforms.

•

Strong portfolio demonstrating UX strategy, UI execution, and measurable impact on business or product metrics.

•

Deep understanding of the Philippine digital payment landscape and regulatory framework.

•

Experience working in agile product development environments, including backlog grooming and sprint planning.

•

Proficiency in design tools (Figma, Adobe XD, or similar) and familiarity with product analytics tools (Amplitude, Mixpanel, Google Analytics, or similar).

•

Background in payments or fintech, and experience designing for mass-market, mobile-first audiences in emerging markets.

•

A track record of proactively identifying and championing product improvements or new features, ideally backed by concrete examples.

•

Personal, regular use of the Coins app (or similar e-wallet/fintech apps) preferred — we want someone who thinks like a power user.

•

High attention to detail, strong written communication (for specs/PRDs), and a collaborative, low-ego approach to working with cross-functional partners.

•

Ability to coordinate with international partners and stakeholders across time zones.

Join the Coins Team Now!

Meaningful Collaborations - The successful candidate will work cross-functionally with other relevant teams to carry out implementations that will improve and create an impact on customer experience.

Scalable Growth - Be part of a fast-growing organization with the vision to expand its territories outside APAC which will provide opportunities for career advancement.

A Space For Bright Ideas - Let your bright ideas be converted into meaningful changes! Coins culture welcomes new ideas backed up by data to create an impact.

The Quant Trading team is responsible for trading and managing risks associated with different crypto products, including spots and derivatives. The team develops and implements trading strategies in fast-paced and complex trading environments.


We are seeking an experienced Trading Analytics Developer to join our Quant Trading team and play a pivotal role in advancing our data and AI infrastructure. This role combines traditional quantitative development with cutting-edge AI platform engineering, focusing on building robust, scalable systems that serve both data analytics and artificial intelligence workloads. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between high-performance trading systems and modern AI capabilities, ensuring reliability, performance, and actionable insights across both domains.


Job Responsibilities
Data Platform & Analytics

• Design, build, and operate high throughput batch and streaming data pipelines using Kafka, Flink, and ETL technologies

• Design and build unified analytics engine designed for processing large-scale data using Apache Spark and related tools

• Develop and optimize analytical data models for time-series, financial metrics, and trading activity

• Implement and manage analytical databases (ClickHouse, MongoDB, BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar) with cost-aware architecture

• Build idempotent data pipelines with robust backfill and reconciliation capabilities

• Create comprehensive monitoring for data quality, freshness, and pipeline reliability

AI Platform Development

• Design, build, and operate internal AI platforms serving multiple trading teams

• Build reusable AI tooling including standardized RAG pipelines, prompt management, and self-service workflows

• Create and maintain agent systems using modern frameworks (LangGraph, A2A, MCP) with focus on controllability and auditability

Job Requirements
Mandatory Foundations

• 5+ years production experience with both Python and Java in high-performance environments

• Strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, data structures, algorithms, data integrity, accuracy and performance optimization

• Expertise in Linux, Github, and modern CI/CD practices

• Proven experience with AWS cloud services and Kubernetes orchestration

• Comfort working with large-scale, complex datasets in financial/trading contexts

Data Platform Expertise

• Advanced SQL with window functions and query optimization, realtime data synchronization together with database design and infrastructure support

• Experience with data workflow and messaging orchestration (Airflow, Jenkins, AMPS etc.)

• Metric design and implementation for trading analytics (PnL, risk, balance and trade reconciliation, backfill and performance tuning)

• Time-series data visualization with Grafana, TradingView, web-based interactive dashboards and BI tools etc.

• Kafka, Flink, and event processing in production environments

AI Platform Capabilities

• Retrieval system evaluation methodologies and quality frameworks

• RAG pipeline architecture and optimization techniques

• LLMOps practices including model lifecycle and prompt management

• Experience with AI agent frameworks in production settings like A2A and MCP

Preferred Qualifications
Financial/Trading Domain

• Experience in trading systems, quantitative finance, or financial technology

• Understanding of market data, data subscription using Rest API / Web Socket

• Knowledge of cryptocurrency markets, defi and related technologies

Professional Attributes

• Excellent problem-solving skills with ability to perform under pressure

• Strong communication skills for cross-team collaboration

• Proactive approach to system reliability and performance optimization

• Continuous learning mindset in rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape

• Balance of practical engineering rigor with innovative solution development

Empowered to think big. Try new opportunities while working with a talented, ambitious and supportive team.
Transformational and proactive working environment. Elevate employees to find thoughtful and innovative solutions.
Growth from within. We help to develop new skill-sets that would impact the shaping of your personal and professional growth.

Medical insurance package with extended coverage to dependents

About the Company

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

The Department: Compliance

Compliance at Gemini is a team dedicated to managing the next generation of financial crime prevention in a complex and evolving regulatory environment. We are a diverse group of technology, legal, and operational professionals who develop new approaches to solving classic problems using cutting edge tools and processes.

The Role: Head of Consumer and Lending Compliance

In this role, you will lead the compliance program for Gemini’s deposit and lending products, including the first-in-class crypto rewards credit card and business credit card. You will be responsible for creating a comprehensive strategy to scale the program and support the business in delivering product features in a compliant and consumer-friendly way. The ideal candidate will have a deep knowledge of consumer finance regulations, be solutions-oriented, and have experience operating in a fast-moving environment. Superior communication skills are essential, as this individual will be required to communicate effectively with various stakeholders, including product, technology, legal, risk, as well as banking partners and regulators. This role reports directly to Gemini’s Global Chief Compliance Officer and has a direct line of communication to the Board.

Responsibilities:

• Oversee the consumer compliance program in accordance with applicable laws and regulations (e.g., UDAAP, ECOA, FCRA, TILA, etc.)

• Serve as the primary advisor to the credit card business and other horizon banking and lending products, providing guidance on new product development, product changes, and marketing initiatives

• Manage a team of compliance professionals responsible for monitoring and testing, complaint management, third party oversight, issue management, compliance reporting, and customer-facing communications, among other areas

• Provide regular reporting to the Board of Managers and other governance committees

• Serve as the primary liaison between Gemini and its sponsor bank partner

• Respond to internal and external audits, examinations, and regulatory inquiries related to credit card card operations

• Oversee risk assessments for consumer banking products, identifying potential areas of risk and working cross-functionally to manage such risks

• Serve as the Fair Lending Officer overseeing the company’s fair lending program

• Ensure proper oversight of vendors and other third parties that present potential compliance or regulatory risk

• Oversee remediation plans for high priority issues to ensure timely remediation and remedy of any compliance-related issues

• Remain up-to-date on regulatory changes and landscapes, best practices and developments in the industry and ensure our implementation is both compliant and forward thinking

• Provide timely and accurate advice and guidance to the Gemini’s staff on issues arising from compliance policy areas and subject matter within the responsibility of the Compliance Department

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree. CRCM or Juris Doctor preferred

• 10+ years of compliance experience in credit, banking, fintech, or other financial regulatory compliance industry and at least 4+ years of experience overseeing a consumer compliance program is a must

• Experience supporting a fast-scaling business

• Possess deep knowledge and real world application of all lending and banking laws and regulations including UDAAP, TILA, TISA, ECOA, FCRA, EFTA, MLA, SCRA, GLBA, and CAN-SPAM

• Proven track record of providing oversight and strategic vision for the entirety of a Compliance Management System (CMS)

It Pays to Work Here

The compensation & benefits package for this role includes:

• Competitive starting pay

• A discretionary annual bonus

• Long-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant

• Comprehensive health plans

• 401K with company matching

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible time off

Salary Range: The base salary range for this role is between $150,500 - $215,000 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. Employees who do not live near one of our hubs are part of our remote workforce. All employees, however, are required to onboard in-person at one of our office locations.

At Gemini, we strive to build diverse teams that reflect the people we want to empower through our products, and we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Equal Opportunity is the Law, and Gemini is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a specific need that requires accommodation, please let a member of the People Team know.

OKX is going all-in on AI-native localisation. The field has long been stuck on one trade-off: you can have translation quality, or you can have scale, but not both. And the real question was never "is this translation accurate?" — it's "can the user actually understand it and get through the flow?"

Web3 is the hardest place to solve this. The vocabulary reinvents itself constantly, with new tech jargon, protocol names and memes appearing every week. It sits next to dense, high-stakes trading terminology, where a single mistranslated word can mislead a user or move money. And every market has its own fast-moving regulations, so the "right" translation is a moving target that must stay compliant across jurisdictions in real time. If you want a localisation problem that is genuinely unsolved — high ambiguity, high stakes, high velocity — this is it.

We're going to break the trade-off with agents. You will own the 0-1 build and launch of two things:

•

A frontier agentic translation system that localises every market (20+ languages) with a human-in-the-loop mechanism.

•

A self-improving agentic QA product that autonomously evaluates translation and end-to-end localisation quality, flags its own failures, and closes the loop.

This is a build-the-frontier role, not a manage-the-vendor role.

This role does not require a linguistics or translation background, multilingual ability, or algorithm engineering skills. We're looking for a PM leader who can build a frontier agentic translation and QA system from 0 to 1 — and make the whole organisation share responsibility for localisation quality.

What You’ll Be Doing

You will lead a squad of product managers and developers, and work hand-in-hand with language managers, to ship the translation and QA systems into production. You set the product direction and quality bar; your PMs and engineers build the agents, harness and evals; and the language managers ground the system in what "good" actually means in each market. Your job is to make these three groups operate as one team — and to make localisation quality something the whole organisation owns, not just the language team.

Own the agentic translation system

Architect and ship it end to end, from 0 to 1, across all markets and 20+ languages — where models carry the work and humans set the standard and make the final call. Break the cost curve: hold quality flat while coverage scales across languages, content and release velocity, so cost stops growing linearly with the business. Make the system interoperate cleanly with OKX's existing localisation stack and content pipelines, rather than living as an island.

Build the agentic QA and quality automation

Stand up an autonomous QA agent that evaluates translation and localisation quality at scale — catching regressions before release, monitoring in production, and self-verifying every fix, using LLM-as-a-judge and eval harnesses rather than manual review. Evaluate not just accuracy and fluency but cultural fit, bias and safety — especially on regulated and financial content, where a wrong or non-compliant phrasing is a real risk. Make quality measurable: define and drive a hard quality signal — human-acceptance rate, or the edit effort needed to reach shippable quality (e.g. Translation Time-to-Edit) — so quality is a metric the system optimises against, not a subjective call. And protect the funnel: conversion on key user journeys should never be adversely affected by language or localisation issues.

Make it self-improving

Drive a sustained reduction in severe and recurring production issues — every escape becomes a new guardrail, and the system gets smarter with every release.

• Proven ability to ship genuinely novel products at the edge of LLM capabilities—and repeat that success here.

• Has built quality systems, automated evaluations, or release gates that enable confident autonomous-system launches.

Support the Regional Head of Risk in overseeing financial and non-financial risks across the region’s entities, preparing analyses and recommendations for review.

Maintain and enhance regional risk frameworks, internal controls, and governance documentation, ensuring alignment with Group standards and regulatory requirements across all relevant jurisdictions.

Serving as the primary operational liaison to the Compliance organization, you will exercise independent analytical judgment to optimize current screening logic while building the foundation for future regulated expansion.

• Current-State QA Auditing & SLA Governance: Execute daily audit sampling across completed IDV, Sanctions, and CIP cases across all Trader Onboarding & Identity Operations team pillars. Track, analyze, and report on SLA attainment, processing bottlenecks, and queue performance metrics.

• Scalable KYC/EDD Framework Development: Establish the operational readiness infrastructure, QA scoring models, decision trees, and testing protocols required to scale operations into regulated entity onboarding pathways involving KYC and EDD.

Model capital velocity and trajectory across trading cycles, establishing early-warning triggers and capital escalation protocols.

Define, calibrate, and enforce market risk limits (NOP, VaR, Expected Shortfall, Greeks) across all CFD asset classes.

Automate daily K-NPR calculations across proprietary books and residual B-Book inventory.

Stress-test firm liabilities arising from statutory Negative Balance Protection (NBP) and extreme market gap events.

Cover for jurisdictional Compliance Officers

BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE


Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout,  xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Pro Verifications team decides whether a business signing up on the Pro side is who it says it is, and whether we're allowed to onboard it. That means figuring out who actually owns the business, running it against sanctions and watchlists, and doing all of it fast enough that a real customer doesn't lose patience and leave. Every Pro customer hits these systems, so slow or wrong is very visible — and the team is early, which means whoever joins gets to decide how a lot of it works instead of inheriting it.

How We Work

 - We deploy constantly, almost always behind a flag, in pieces small enough to pull back fast.

 - Security and compliance show up at design time, not as a gate at the end.

 - Every story is tied to a metric it's meant to move — if work isn't on the board, it doesn't get staffed.

 - At this level, you're expected to shape these standards, not just work inside them.

 


THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Staff Engineer on Pro Verifications, you'll own the technical direction for how verification is built here — the architecture, the patterns other engineers work inside, and the calls about what we own versus what we lean on a vendor for. You'll be hands-on across the stack, drive out entire classes of recurring failure rather than patching them one at a time, and design the fail-closed and audit behavior that keeps regulators satisfied.

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role for engineers who've built where being wrong has real consequences, and who want to shape a system that stays fast, safe, and defensible as it grows.

 - Set the shape of the verification services and their contracts across the KYC/KYB flow.

 - Decide how we abstract KYC and KYB vendors so a bad provider day doesn't turn into an outage.

 - Design fail-closed behavior and audit trails that hold up under regulatory scrutiny.

 - Identify the classes of failure that keep recurring and remove them for good.

 - Write and drive architecture decisions (ADRs), and hold the line on security and compliance at design time, not as a late gate.

 - Mentor and raise the bar for senior engineers through design reviews, code, and direct feedback.

 - Be measured on whether verification gets faster, more of it decides itself, fewer decisions are wrong, and the systems stay up — and on whether the team got stronger for you being on it.

 


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Around eight years building and running production systems, with a track record of owning a domain's technical direction, not just delivering inside one.

 - Deep, fluent expertise in Rust, with the versatility to work across TypeScript and React where verification meets the customer.

 - You've set architecture other people build on, and it held up — you can point to specific classes of failure you designed out, not just incidents you fixed.

Key Responsibilities:
Internal Audit Strategy & Governance
• Define and maintain the Internal Audit strategy, methodology and multi-year audit plan, aligned with Swissquote's business model, risk profile and regulatory requirements.
• Establish, maintain and periodically review the Internal Audit Charter and ensure Board approval and alignment with regulatory and professional standards.
• Develop a risk-based audit universe and annual audit plan, ensuring appropriate coverage of material financial, operational, technological and regulatory risks.
• Ensure that Internal Audit operates in accordance with applicable FINMA requirements and recognised professional standards.
• Regularly assess the effectiveness and adequacy of the Internal Audit framework and continuously improve its methodology, tools and processes.
• Maintain an appropriate level of independence from the activities and functions being audited.
• Establish safeguards ensuring objectivity and independence of the Internal Audit function and address any actual, potential or perceived impairments.
• Lead and personally perform selected audits in areas where the Head of Internal Audit’s expertise is most relevant or where the use of external resources is not justified by risk, complexity, or cost.
• Maintain overall accountability for the quality, supervision and reliance placed on work performed by co-sourcing partners and external specialists.
• Across the years, progressively build and develop the Internal Audit team in line with the evolution of the function and the organisation’s risk profile, with strong emphasis on internal development, cross-functional exposure and the development of future audit talent. Establish a clear vision for a lean and digitally enabled Internal Audit function, including the development of data analytics, IT audit capabilities, automated monitoring and management dashboards.
• Design, implement and maintain a Quality Assurance and Improvement Program (QAIP) covering internal and external assessments, performance measurement and continuous improvement of the Internal Audit function and ensure the QAIP is assessed in accordance with Global Internal Audit Standards.
• Develop and manage the Internal Audit budget and resource plan, ensuring sufficient capabilities and capacity to fulfil the approved audit plan.
• Establish and report performance metrics demonstrating the effectiveness, efficiency and value contribution of Internal Audit.
Risk & Control Assurance
• Provide independent assurance to the Board and Executive Management on the effectiveness of Swissquote's governance, risk management and internal control framework, through a risk-based and forward-looking audit approach.
• Lead the assessment of risks across the organisation and ensure that the Internal Audit plan evolves in line with Swissquote's risk profile and business strategy.
• Challenge management constructively on significant control weaknesses, risk exposures and remediation plans, ensuring that material findings are appropriately addressed and escalated when necessary.
Board and Audit & Risk Committee
• Act as the primary Internal Audit advisor to the Board of Directors and its Audit & Risk Committee, providing an independent view on the overall effectiveness of Swissquote's governance, risk management and control environment.
• Present and discuss the Internal Audit Charter, the Internal Audit strategy, annual plan, key findings, emerging risk themes and QIAP.
Regulatory & External Stakeholder Management
• Maintain a constructive relationship with FINMA, the external audit firm and other relevant regulatory stakeholders.
• Coordinate, where appropriate, with external audit and other assurance functions (internal and external) to ensure appropriate coverage and avoid unnecessary duplication.
• Ensure that Internal Audit is prepared to respond effectively to regulatory reviews and supervisory expectations.
• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their implications for the Internal Audit plan.
Digital & Technology Audit
• Ensure adequate audit coverage of IT architecture, applications, infrastructure and technology governance.
• Assess cybersecurity, identity and access management, data management and technology resilience.
• Review the governance and control environment surrounding AI and emerging technologies.
• AI fluency, with demonstrated experience, a strong sensitivity to AI-related topics, and the ability to confidently assess and challenge AI-generated outputs.
• Develop appropriate use of data analytics and automation within Internal Audit.
• Ensure Internal Audit evolves alongside Swissquote's technology and digital transformation.
People Leadership
• Build, lead, develop and motivate the Internal Audit team and foster a strong culture of professional scepticism, independence, integrity and continuous improvement.
• Attract, develop, and retain top talents while ensuring clear roles, performance goals, and career progression paths.
• Ensure appropriate professional development and certification of Internal Audit professionals.

Qualifications
Education & Professional Qualifications
• Master's degree or equivalent in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, Law or another relevant discipline from a recognised university.
• Professional Internal Audit qualification, Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) or Federal Diploma as a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) is a must.
• In-depth knowledge of the Swiss banking regulatory environment and FINMA requirements, particularly in relation to corporate governance, risk management, internal controls and Internal Audit.
• Ability to assess the effectiveness, scope, documentation, and lessons learned from the previously outsourced internal audit model.
• Build strong working relationships with senior management while reinforcing the independent role of internal audit.
• Strong understanding of international banking regulation and recognised industry practices.
• Excellent analytical, communication, report-writing, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
• High level of integrity, independence, professional judgment, and discretion.
• Strong business acumen with the ability to identify emerging strategic, operational, financial, and compliance risks.
• English is a must, French and German an asset.
Professional Experience
• 10+ years of relevant experience in internal/external audit, risk management and assessment, compliance or a closely related function within financial services.
• At least 3 years as a Head Internal Audit, Internal Audit Director, or Big 4 Senior Manager/Director, preferably with direct exposure to the Board of Directors and/or Audit Committee, ideally with an experience managing co-sourced or outsourced audit providers.

• Proven ability to interact effectively with FINMA, external auditors, the Board/Audit Committee and senior management.
• Significant international exposure and experience working across multiple jurisdictions.

Additional Information
Please note that Swissquote never requests sensitive personal information or payment of any kind during the recruitment process. Any such request is fraudulent.

Assess the Status Quo — Develop an end-to-end understanding of the campaign lifecycle and available data assets; identify all decision points currently reliant on manual judgment (opportunity identification, audience selection, budget estimation, campaign mechanics design, post-campaign review) and determine where intelligent automation yields the highest return.

•

What Campaign to Run — Mine campaign opportunities from user behavior, product and market signals, and historical campaign performance; build an AI Agent that outputs candidate campaign themes with clear supporting evidence, not just a ranked list.

•

Who to Target — Build or reuse user segmentation and response/propensity models; apply uplift modeling to direct budget toward truly incremental audiences who would be influenced, rather than users who would convert anyway.

•

How Much Budget — Build a cost-benefit model: projected participation, incremental trading volume / revenue, ROI simulation, budget allocation recommendations, and sensitivity and risk analysis (including abuse and reward-farming risks under incentive designs).

•

Feasibility Analysis & Plan Design — Translate model outputs into a reviewable proposal: objectives, mechanics, target audience, budget, expected KPIs, and risk control boundaries; align with PM, Growth, and business stakeholders.

•

MVP Delivery — Implement the end-to-end pipeline (data → model → recommendation → campaign configuration → A/B or holdout evaluation); run it on at least one real campaign or rigorous backtest; quantify improvement relative to the current manual decision-making baseline.

Undergraduate or graduate student in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or a related field.

•

Solid proficiency in SQL and Python. Experience with real-time / streaming tech stacks (Flink, Kafka) is a plus.

•

Data science foundations relevant to this project: A/B experiment design, causal inference and uplift modeling, propensity/response models, and basic predictive modeling. Must be able to distinguish correlation from incremental effect.

•

Hands-on experience with LLM application development: prompt engineering, RAG, Agent / tool-calling frameworks; able to use LLMs for reasoning and orchestration on top of quantitative models.

•

Business acumen: genuine interest in fintech / crypto and growth marketing; able to translate a business question ("Should we run a trading competition next month?") into a data problem, and translate the conclusion back into an actionable decision for business stakeholders.

•

Strong communication skills — this role sits at the intersection of data, PM, and growth/marketing.

•

Bonus: experience in growth / CRM / campaign analytics, recommendation systems, or marketing mix modeling background.

•

Minimum 3-month internship commitment, 5 days per week on-site.

•

Fluent in Mandarin is required.

We’re hiring an ML Ops Engineer to build and operate the platform capabilities that take machine-learning models from experimentation into reliable production services.

You’ll own the automation, deployment, observability and operational controls around the ML lifecycle, working closely with research engineers, software engineers, platform teams and product teams.

This is not a research role. It is a hands-on engineering role focused on making ML systems reproducible, scalable, secure and dependable, from model packaging and release through to serving, monitoring, retraining and incident response.

What you’ll work on
ML lifecycle and platform engineering
• Build repeatable workflows for model training, validation, promotion, deployment and retraining.
• Productionise models through packaging, versioning, model registry integration, deployment automation and safe rollback.
• Design CI/CD pipelines for ML systems, including automated testing, validation, release controls and environment promotion.
• Manage experiment tracking, model metadata and reproducibility across research and production.
• Build reusable tooling and platform capabilities that support multiple models and engineering teams.
Model serving and observability
• Deploy and operate batch and online inference services in containerised cloud environments.
• Define and meet availability, latency, throughput and recovery objectives for ML services.
• Monitor service health, infrastructure, data-quality signals, data drift, prediction drift and model performance decay.
• Establish dashboards, alerting and operational runbooks so failures are detected and resolved quickly.
• Support automated or controlled retraining, model promotion, rollback and model retirement.
• Debug production issues across model, application, infrastructure and critical data-dependency layers.
Reliability, security and engineering quality
• Improve system robustness, scalability and cost efficiency through automation, observability and infrastructure as code.
• Write production-grade Python for long-running services, deployment tooling and ML workflows.
• Establish testing, validation, release and incident-management practices for ML systems.
• Collaborate with platform, security and data engineering teams on reliable model inputs, access controls, secrets, resilience and compliance.
• Make explicit trade-offs between research flexibility, delivery speed, operational risk and production stability.

About the role
We are looking for a Data Analyst to transform high-velocity data into clear financial insights that inform and strengthen our trading strategies.
Working with real-time data pipelines built on Kafka, RabbitMQ, and ClickHouse, you will help ensure that P&L reporting and trading analytics are accurate, timely, and actionable. Positioned at the intersection of engineering and finance, this role requires strong technical and analytical capabilities, along with a solid understanding of financial markets.

Responsibility
• Develop and maintain automated PnL reporting frameworks that pull from real-time data streams.
• Conduct deep-dive trading analytics to identify execution patterns, slippage, and market impact.
• Write and optimise complex SQL queries in ClickHouse to handle large-scale financial datasets efficiently.
• Collaborate with stakeholders to define and implement key performance indicators (KPIs) for various trading desks.
• Monitor data quality and integrity across the pipeline to ensure financial reporting remains compliant and accurate.
• Use Python to build robust data processing scripts that automate repetitive analytical tasks.
• Design data models and schemas that specifically support high-frequency reporting and business objectives.

Requirements
Must have
• University degree in Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
• Prior experience working within the finance or fintech industry, with an understanding of financial instruments or trading data.
• Advanced SQL knowledge and experience with OLAP databases like ClickHouse.
• Strong programming skills in Python for data manipulation and automation tasks.
• Experience with data visualisation tools to represent real-time data effectively.
• Ability to convey technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on data accuracy and compliance with governance policies.
Nice to have
• Exposure to ClickHouse (or another columnar/OLAP store — Druid, BigQuery, Snowflake)
• Airflow or similar orchestration; dbt; Git-based workflows
• BI tooling (Superset, Metabase, Power BI, Grafana)
Benefits
• Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
• Opportunities for career growth and development within a global company.
• Collaborative and inclusive work environment with exposure to cross-region operations.
• Health and wellness benefits.
• Flexible working arrangements.

Who we are

We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.

Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

Your Mission

At Bitpanda, we know that amazing customer service builds trust and lasting connections. As a Customer Support Associate, you’ll be the go-to person our users turn to — answering questions, solving problems, and making sure they always feel supported.

This role is the perfect way to kickstart your career in fintech if you’re fresh out of uni or just starting your journey. You’ll get hands-on experience in a fast-moving, international environment, learn directly from an experienced team, and grow your skills from day one.

Every conversation you have will help shape how people experience Bitpanda — and help you grow into the next stage of your career. 🚀

What You Will Do

• Be the first point of contact for our users via live chat and tickets — always keeping your communication clear, friendly, and fast.

• Help customers solve everyday issues and make their Bitpanda journey smooth, positive, and stress-free.

• Share feedback and ideas with the team to improve the way we support our users and make the customer journey even better.

• Work towards team goals like fast response times and high customer satisfaction while staying up to date with Bitpanda’s products and features.

• Be flexible with a shift-based schedule (including evenings and weekends) — planned in advance so you can balance work and life.

Who You Are

• You’re an empathetic and friendly communicator who enjoys helping people and can stay calm, reliable, and positive even when things get busy.

• You speak fluent English and another EU language is an advantage

• You’re curious about fintech, investing, or crypto and excited to learn more (bonus points if you already know your way around crypto wallets, DEXs, or trading).

• You’re detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable juggling multiple chats at once while still delivering clear, high-quality answers.

• You thrive in a fast-paced, international environment and love working as part of a team.

Why Join Us?

• Be part of an ambitious, fast-growing fintech company, working alongside passionate people who love what they do.

• Play a key role in shaping the customer experience at Bitpanda and directly influence user satisfaction and loyalty.

• Get real exposure to the world of investing, crypto, and financial services, no prior expertise required, just curiosity.

• Enjoy plenty of career growth opportunities, training, and the chance to move across teams as you grow.

• Thrive in a supportive, international team culture where your ideas and feedback matter.

What’s in it for you

• Flexibility to work where you thrive – Enjoy the freedom of our Hybrid working model, combining onsite collaboration and remote work, with an additional 25 days per year to work from a city or country of your choice.

• Reward for your impact – Receive a competitive total compensation package aligned with Bitpanda’s pay-for-impact policy, including participation in our stock option plan.

• Support for your mental wellbeing – Access confidential coaching, counselling, and mental health resources whenever you need them through OpenUP.

• Time to recharge – On top of your standard annual leave, prioritise your wellbeing in 2027 with 3 additional days of paid time off to rest, reset, and recharge, available once you’ve been with us for 6 months.

• Continuous learning and growth – Grow your skills and stay ahead in your career with unlimited access to Udemy’s library of online courses at your own pace.

• Exclusive perks and rewards – Enjoy discounts, rewards, and perks from partners worldwide across lifestyle, wellness, tech, and travel.

• Support during life milestones – Take advantage of up to 8 additional weeks of gender-neutral new parent leave to welcome and bond with your new addition to the family.

• Fuel and focus on-site – Pandas in Vienna, Bucharest, Barcelona, and Berlin can enjoy free onsite dining, with freshly prepared lunches and snacks to keep you fueled and focused all day long.

• Recognition for your contributions – Celebrate milestones and achievements with recognition and rewards for your Tenure at Bitpanda.

• Show your Bitpanda pride – Access exclusive Bitpanda-branded merchandise and gear to represent.

• Connect and celebrate with your team – Join unforgettable company events, from our Winter Party in Vienna to gatherings worldwide, fostering fun, connection, and celebration

.…and even more location-specific benefits designed to make life at Bitpanda even more rewarding wherever you are.

Above all, you will have the opportunity to learn and grow as part of Bitpanda’s incredible journey towards being Europe’s future #1 investment platform.

Bitpanda is committed to fostering a fair and equal environment based on trust and mutual respect. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is paramount to our success and we are committed to building a team that represents a wide variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

You’ll apply your CFD/forex regulatory expertise across licensing, AFSL obligations, compliance monitoring and strategic business initiatives in a fast-paced, international environment.

Key Responsibilities:
• Complete assigned licence applications, renewals, variations and ongoing regulatory requirements across multiple jurisdictions.
• Prepare, review and coordinate licensing documentation, regulatory submissions, statutory filings and supporting materials.
• Monitor licensing status, regulatory deadlines and compliance obligations, escalating material risks or delays where required.
• Liaise with regulators, external advisers, local agents and corporate service providers on assigned regulatory and compliance matters.
• Maintain and enhance compliance policies, procedures, registers and internal controls in line with applicable regulatory requirements.
• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their potential impact on the Company’s products, services and operations.
• Conduct compliance reviews, risk assessments and control testing to identify gaps, emerging risks and opportunities for improvement.
• Support the assessment, investigation and reporting of potential breaches, complaints, incidents and control failures.
• Prepare compliance reports, risk updates and regulatory information for management and relevant governance bodies.
• Coordinate compliance support for internal and external audits, regulatory reviews and supervisory enquiries.
• Provide practical compliance guidance to internal departments on business activities, operational processes and regulatory requirements.
• Review CFD products, client disclosures, marketing materials, business initiatives and process changes from a compliance perspective.
• Conduct legal and regulatory research and assist with the review of commercial agreements, governance documents and related legal-risk matters.
• Lead assigned compliance projects and workstreams, coordinating with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate delivery.
• Provide technical guidance and peer review to junior team members where required, without formal people-management responsibility.
• Work closely with subsidiary compliance teams to support consistent regulatory standards and timely escalation of issues across jurisdictions.
Requirements
• At least three years’ relevant compliance, regulatory or legal experience, with the capability to operate independently at Senior Compliance Officer level.
• Compliance experience applying Australian regulatory requirements to CFDs, forex, OTC derivatives, leveraged trading or online broking.
• Strong knowledge of AFSL obligations and the Australian regulatory framework applicable to retail OTC derivatives and CFDs.
• Practical experience in areas such as DDO/TMD, breach reporting, complaints and AFCA matters, AML/CTF, client money, disclosure or marketing compliance.
• Strong regulatory judgement, drafting, communication and stakeholder management skills.
• Professional proficiency in spoken and written English and Mandarin, sufficient to prepare compliance documentation and communicate effectively with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders.
• Broader AFSL regulatory or financial services legal experience will be highly regarded.
• Relevant legal, compliance, risk, or finance qualifications are desirable.
Benefits
• Competitive remuneration, including performance-based bonus opportunities.
• Opportunities to develop your expertise and progress your career within a global business.
• Broad exposure to cross-regional operations and international stakeholders.
• A collaborative, inclusive and supportive team environment.
• Flexible working arrangements aligned with role and business requirements.
• Access to health and wellbeing benefits.

Create and improve search-led content that matches intent and supports conversion, covering both traditional SEO and Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO) for AI-driven search and answer engines. Focus is content quality, structure, refresh cadence, on-page optimisation, and content performance, with consistent use of approved wording patterns, required risk language, and adherence to E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) and YMYL (Your Money or Your Life) content standards.
Key responsibilities:
• Write and update high-intent SEO content (commercial pages, comparison pages, FAQs, education where it supports intent).
• Write content optimised for GEO (Generative Engine Optimisation), structuring and phrasing content so it can be clearly understood, cited, and surfaced by AI-driven search and answer engines (e.g. ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews), alongside traditional SEO.
• Maintain a refresh plan: identify decay, update content, and improve coverage gaps.
• Conduct keyword research to identify content opportunities, search intent, and coverage gaps across markets, feeding findings into the content plan.
• Grow First Time Trader (FTT) volumes from generic, non-brand keyword terms through SEO content, reducing reliance on brand search and expanding acquisition from new audiences.
• Apply on-page best practice: headings, structure, internal linking updates, meta inputs, and content QA before publish.
• Localise (rather than directly translate) content for country-specific websites, adapting to local search intent and market nuances while avoiding content cannibalisation, duplication, and duplicate-content flags across the global site network.
• Manage and coordinate content across multiple global/country websites, maintaining consistency of structure, tone, and compliance while reflecting local relevance.
• Write and edit content in line with E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) and YMYL (Your Money or Your Life) principles, reflecting the standards required for financial content.
• Review content performance (rankings, organic traffic, engagement, conversion) and use insights to optimise existing content and improve rankings.
• Work within compliance constraints and use approved claims and risk language patterns.
Requirements
• Strong SEO writing and editing, with clear understanding of intent and SERP formats.
• Ability to follow content templates and create consistent, scannable structures.
• High attention to detail, accuracy, and deadline discipline.
• Comfortable with feedback loops and iteration based on performance data.
• Understanding of GEO principles and how content is surfaced and cited by AI/LLM-driven search and answer engines.
• Strong keyword research skills, using SEO tools to identify search intent, opportunity, and content gaps.
• Experience managing content across global/multi-country websites, with a good understanding of avoiding content cannibalisation and duplication.
• Good working knowledge of E-E-A-T and YMYL content requirements, ideally within a regulated or financial services environment.
• Performance-led approach; confident reviewing content performance data and optimising content to improve rankings.
• Experience with Storyblok CMS advantageous.

Performance Measures
• Content shipped and refreshed to plan, with on-time delivery and low rework rate.
• Improvement in performance of priority pages (rankings, traffic quality, engagement).
• Increase in FTTs sourced from generic/non-brand keyword terms, with a growing share of organic conversions coming from non-brand SEO content.
• Content quality maintained: fewer compliance revisions, fewer factual errors, consistent structure.
• Refresh cadence maintained with clear tracking of what changed and why.
• Improved visibility and citation of content within AI-driven search and answer engines (GEO performance).
• Successful localisation of content across country/language websites with no cannibalisation, duplication, or duplicate-content issues flagged.
Benefits

• Competitive salary, and discretionary annual bonus.
• Private healthcare.
• Life Insurance, Critical Illness & Income Protection cover.
• Active Lifestyle allowance.
• Annual leave above minimum entitlement.
• Up to 3 weeks allowance to work in any location.
• Enhanced parental leave packages.

会社紹介
ビットバンクはSBIグループの一員として新たな成長を目指す、暗号資産専業のスタートアップ企業です。
「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに暗号資産技術の応用によって、人々の生活にビットコインが浸透し普及することを目指しています。
180名を超える社員のうち、20代〜30代のメンバーが約70％と若手中心ですが、40代以上の経験豊富なベテランも多数在籍しています。
同じビジョンを共有するメンバーが、それぞれの専門性を活かしながら、日々挑戦と成長を重ねています。私たちは当社が掲げるVision、Missionに共感し、そして3つのValuesを大切にしています。
■主なサービス
【bitbank. cc】
ビットコインをはじめ幅広く取り揃えた豊富な銘柄を取り扱っており、シンプルで軽量なデザインに加え、高い機能性を備えたスマートな取引所です。
また、金融庁の認可を受けた暗号資産交換業者として、安全性と信頼性の高い取引環境を実現しています
■子会社情報
【Bitbank Ventures合同会社（Bitbank Ventures）】
Bitbank Ventures株式会社は、ビットバンク株式会社の100%出資により設立された投資子会社です。
暗号資産やブロックチェーンによるインターネット上の新たな価値移転の可能性に加え、AI技術の進化により注目される「AI × クリプト」領域など、将来を見据えた先端技術の動向を的確に捉えながら、未来の社会を支える革新的な取り組みを支援することを目的としています。
Vision
オープンでフェアな社会を実現する
Mission
ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる
Values
【 Integrity 】
何事にも真摯に取り組み、関わるすべての人を尊重する。
率直に意見し、言行に責任をもち、誠実であることを誇る。
【 Challenge 】
あらゆるチャンスを素早く捉え、失敗を恐れず、自らチャレンジし続ける。
【 One team 】
仲間を信じ、仲間と取り組み、仲間と共に成長する。

経営管理部は、月次・四半期・年度決算、資金管理、税務対応などの財務経理業務に加え、暗号資産交換業者として重要な分別管理業務、貸金業に関する業務、予算策定・予実管理、新商品・サービスのリリースに向けた全社プロジェクトへの対応など、会社の経営と事業運営を横断的に支える役割を担っています。

About the Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and detail-oriented Reconciliation & Settlement Manager to take ownership of the reconciliation and settlement processes across our payment and financial operations.

The role will be responsible for ensuring that transactions are accurately reconciled, funds are settled correctly and on time, discrepancies are identified and resolved promptly, and financial movements across multiple accounts, currencies, payment channels and partners are properly controlled.

The role will have particular responsibility for supporting cross-border payment flows, including monitoring settlement across different markets, currencies, banking/payment partners and transaction channels.

This is a critical role within the business, sitting at the intersection of Finance, Payments, Operations, Treasury, Risk and Compliance.

Responsibilities

Reconciliation Management

• Own the end-to-end reconciliation process across all relevant transaction and payment channels.
• Perform daily reconciliation of customer transactions against internal ledgers, bank accounts, wallets and payment/settlement partner records.
• Reconcile fiat and digital asset transactions where applicable.
• Ensure all transactions are accurately recorded, accounted for and appropriately classified.
• Identify reconciliation breaks, unmatched transactions, duplicate transactions, missing entries and other discrepancies.
• Investigate and resolve reconciliation exceptions within defined timelines.
• Maintain accurate reconciliation schedules and supporting documentation.
• Ensure outstanding reconciliation items are properly tracked through to resolution.
• Develop and maintain reconciliation controls to minimise financial leakage and operational errors.

Settlement Management

• Own and coordinate settlement processes across banking, payment and liquidity partners.
• Ensure settlements are completed accurately and within agreed timelines.
• Monitor settlement positions across currencies, accounts and payment channels.
• Coordinate settlement instructions and confirmations with relevant internal and external stakeholders.
• Monitor failed, delayed, rejected or incomplete settlements and ensure timely resolution.
• Maintain appropriate settlement records and evidence for audit and reporting purposes.
• Identify settlement risks and escalate material issues appropriately.

Cross-Border Payments

• Manage reconciliation and settlement processes associated with cross-border payment transactions.
• Monitor movement of funds across different currencies, jurisdictions, banking partners and payment channels.
• Reconcile inbound and outbound cross-border transactions across relevant accounts and systems.
• Track transaction status from initiation through processing, settlement and final reconciliation.
• Investigate discrepancies arising from FX conversion, fees, exchange-rate differences, intermediary charges, timing differences and settlement delays.
• Work with banking and payment partners to resolve cross-border settlement issues.
• Monitor foreign exchange and settlement costs and identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
• Maintain appropriate records for cross-border transactions and support required operational and regulatory reporting.

Partner & Banking Operations

• Manage operational relationships with banks, payment service providers, liquidity providers and other settlement partners.
• Monitor partner balances, settlement accounts and transaction positions.
• Validate partner statements and settlement reports against internal records.
• Investigate partner discrepancies and coordinate resolution.
• Monitor agreed SLAs and settlement performance.
• Support the onboarding and integration of new payment and settlement partners from a reconciliation and settlement perspective.
• Maintain a clear record of partner-specific settlement processes and requirements.

Exception Management

• Establish and maintain an effective exception management process.
• Monitor unresolved reconciliation and settlement exceptions.
• Categorise exceptions according to value, risk, age and root cause.
• Escalate high-value, unusual or prolonged exceptions.
• Conduct root-cause analysis of recurring reconciliation and settlement issues.
• Work with Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance and external partners to resolve systemic issues.
• Recommend process or system improvements to reduce recurring exceptions.

Treasury & Liquidity Coordination

• Monitor operational balances required to support settlement and payment obligations.
• Identify potential liquidity gaps or excess balances across accounts and currencies.
• Work closely with Treasury/Finance to ensure adequate funding for settlement activities.
• Support liquidity planning for cross-border payment corridors.
• Monitor currency exposures and settlement requirements.
• Provide timely information to Finance and management to support liquidity decisions.

Controls & Risk Management

• Develop and maintain strong reconciliation and settlement controls.
• Ensure appropriate segregation of duties across transaction processing, reconciliation and settlement activities.
• Monitor transactions and settlement processes for operational risks and potential financial losses.
• Work closely with Risk and Compliance on issues relating to transaction integrity, suspicious activity, fraud risks and regulatory requirements.
• Ensure appropriate approval and authorisation controls are followed.
• Support internal and external audits by providing reconciliation and settlement documentation.
• Maintain appropriate records and evidence for all material financial movements.

Requirements

Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
• 6+ years' experience in reconciliation, settlement, payments operations, treasury operations, financial operations or a related field

• Experience managing high-volume financial transactions and reconciliation processes.
• Experience working with banks, payment service providers, fintechs or financial institutions.
• Experience with cross-border payments and multi-currency transactions is strongly preferred.
• Experience managing settlement processes across multiple banking/payment partners.
• Experience leading or supervising a finance operations/reconciliation team.

Technical Skills

• Strong understanding of financial reconciliation and settlement processes.
• Strong understanding of payment flows and transaction lifecycles.
• Knowledge of cross-border payment processes and FX settlement.
• Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
• Experience working with financial systems, payment platforms, ERPs or reconciliation tools.
• Experience with data analysis and reporting.
• Familiarity with SQL, BI tools or automated reconciliation systems is an advantage.
• Strong understanding of financial controls and operational risk.

Nice to Have

• High attention to detail — zero-error mindset.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to manage multiple deadlines across jurisdictions.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Integrity, confidentiality, and high professional ethics.

• Run hands-on, role-specific training and produce the enablement material that explains what we've built to a non-technical audience.

• Instrument and measure adoption closely enough to know what's working, who has dropped off, and why — owning the outcome rather than the ticket.

• Work with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, plan sprints, and take part in architecture reviews so solutions scale and meet security and performance standards.

• Provide clear project updates, documentation, and technical insight to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Contribute to coding standards and best practices through code reviews and knowledge-sharing.

• Keep pace with developments in full-stack engineering, AI tooling, and automation, and experiment with new LLM and agent capabilities that could improve our products.

Are you the one?

• Have at least 3 years of relevant working experience in AI, software engineering, or a related technical field; the role is not intended for fresh graduates or very junior profiles.

• Hands-on experience with AI Agents, AI applications, or LLM-based solutions, ideally in a production environment.

• Proven experience scaling and enhancing AI products or solutions, including taking existing AI applications, code, or technologies and expanding their usage across teams, markets, or the wider organisation.

• Strong technical experience with Python, LLMs, APIs, databases, and AI platforms/tools.

• Able to work with existing code and solutions, identify opportunities for improvement, and help grow and scale existing AI products rather than focusing only on building new solutions from scratch.

• Experience with AI chatbots, voice agents, or similar AI applications would be an advantage.

• Knowledge or experience with RPA/automation platforms such as UiPath, Automation Anywhere, or Power Automate would be a plus.

• Experience in fintech, financial services, trading, or a similar industry would be an advantage, but is not essential.

• Strong problem-solving, collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work with different teams and stakeholders across the organisation.

Axi's bag of delights

• Competitive and attractive compensation.

• Extensive learning opportunities, such as professional training and certifications and soft skills development.

• Hiring Team Interview (1 hour)

About The Opportunity

The Core Trading Risk Product team builds the core trading infrastructure and platform-level risk capabilities that support OKX’s spot and derivatives businesses across multiple account and margin modes.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the delivery of trading risk workflow automation, agentic parameter governance, agent-driven execution, and foundational price-protection capabilities. Your scope will also include margin-tier rules, collateral haircuts, price limits, index price, and mark price across spot, derivatives, and Perp DEX scenarios.

You will work closely with Risk Management, Quantitative Research, Engineering, Data, Trading Operations, Legal, Compliance, and regional market teams to translate risk-control methodologies into configurable, verifiable, and observable platform capabilities. Success in this role means continuously improving liquidity, users’ capital efficiency, and the trading experience while safeguarding platform resilience and market integrity.

What You’ll Be Doing

• Drive product planning and roadmap execution. Own product discovery and delivery across risk parameter governance, AI-agent workflow automation, controlled execution, and price protection. Translate risk-control needs and operating SOPs into product requirements, priorities, 3-12-month delivery plans, and success metrics; partner with engineering, risk, quant, data, and operations teams to launch, measure adoption, and iterate.

• Research and iterate on risk-control methodologies. Research, formulate, and continuously improve risk-control methodologies, including pricing logic, risk-scoring models, and approaches for handling market volatility.

• Build platform-level risk controls. Build and optimize platform-level risk-control mechanisms to ensure stability under extreme market conditions.

• Drive effective implementation of risk systems. Collaborate with engineers, quants, data analysts, and other stakeholders to ensure risk systems are effectively implemented and continuously monitored.

• Drive continuous improvement. Continuously improve the product through feedback loops and retrospective analysis of past market incidents or system performance.

•

Stay close to markets and users. Maintain regular communication with traders, institutional clients, and market-making teams. Continuously study crypto and traditional financial market structures, competitor mechanisms, and regulatory changes; determine when to lead and when to fast-follow; and adjust product priorities accordingly.

•

Strengthen team methodologies and AI leverage. Codify risk product methodologies, decision records, parameter dictionaries, and incident case libraries, and mentor other product managers. Design automation and AI-native workflows to improve efficiency in analysis, configuration review, monitoring and troubleshooting, documentation, and product operations..

What We Look For In You

• Five or more years of product management experience in trading-related domains. Be familiar with trading system principles, understanding users' trading, and be able to identify risky scenarios.

• An AI-native approach to work, with the ability to design multi-step automation or agentic workflows incorporating tool use, retrieval, evaluation, and human-review checkpoints, together with an understanding of the access-control and audit boundaries required in risk-control contexts.

• Strong systems thinking and technical judgment, with the ability to work closely with engineering and quantitative teams on real-time, highly available, data-intensive systems and the related configuration, monitoring, resilience, and audit requirements.

• Experience in data-driven product decision-making and risk change management, with the ability to define effective metrics and drive continuous improvement through simulation, backtesting, stress testing, production monitoring, and incident reviews.

• Mature cross-functional leadership and project execution capabilities.

• Rigorous logical thinking, clear written and verbal communication, and fluency in both Chinese and English, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients and cross-functional teams across global and Chinese-language working environments.

• A bachelor’s degree or higher, preferably in a quantitative or technical field such as Computer Science, Finance, Engineering, or Mathematics.

Nice-To-Haves

•

A deep understanding of the trading and risk mechanisms for spot, margin, perpetuals, expiry futures, or options, with familiarity with core concepts including the order lifecycle, margin, leverage, liquidation, position tiers, index price, mark price, and price limits.

•

Experience working at a digital asset exchange, securities or futures exchange, brokerage, clearing platform, market-making firm, quantitative trading firm, or another high-throughput trading environment.

•

Experience scaling automation, AI agents, or human-in-the-loop workflows in safety-critical environments.

Perks & Benefits

•

Competitive total compensation package

• L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development

•

Various team building programs and company events

• Wellness and meal allowances

• Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

• More that we love to tell you along the process!

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Payments Team, based in the US. Payments is where OKX meets the real financial world. Our team has built and operates the infrastructure connecting OKX to dozens of payment channels across global markets, giving users deposit and withdrawal options that are fast, convenient, and — most importantly — trustworthy. That platform moves and safeguards user assets at institutional scale, continuously, across time zones and regulatory environments.

This is not a greenfield team looking for its footing. The team is established, the platform is in production at scale, and we are actively expanding — both in scope and in headcount. That combination is rare: you get the leverage of joining a growing team where your work visibly shifts the roadmap, along with the discipline that comes from a system already trusted with real money.

It's also an unusually good place to learn. Payments is a domain that's hard to pick up from the outside — every market has its own rails, its own settlement behavior, its own failure modes, its own compliance expectations. Here you'll work across a wide range of payment methods and channels, and you'll build the judgment that comes from operating financial systems where the stakes are real: how to design for correctness when money is on the line, how to reconcile, how to recover, how to keep a platform observable enough that you find problems before your users do.

You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and partner-facing teams, and you'll set the technical bar for the engineers around you — through design docs, code reviews, and the everyday habit of doing things properly when nobody's watching.

If you like the sound of a team where the problems are genuinely hard, the standard is high, and your opinion changes the outcome, we'd like to talk.

What You’ll Be Doing

•

Design and build the core. Develop high-scale, 24/7 APIs and distributed payment services across multiple cloud providers, using Java and Spring Boot as the primary stack. Own systems end to end — from design doc through production ownership.

•

Expand our global reach. Help integrate and scale new payment channels and methods across markets, each with its own technical, operational, and reliability characteristics.

•

Protect user assets. Build for correctness first: consistency, idempotency, reconciliation, failure recovery, and the operational tooling that lets us stand behind every transaction.

•

Set the technical bar. Participate actively in design and code reviews, giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback. Help evolve the standards a growing team builds on.

•

Solve the hard problems. Investigate complex distributed-systems challenges and drive them to resolution rather than handing them off.

•

Partner across functions. Work with product, design, and partner teams across regions to turn ambiguous requirements into shipped systems, and to unblock dependencies before they become delays.

•

Grow the team's capability. Mentor engineers and share what you learn. Seniority here is measured in leverage, not just output.

•

Stay curious. Keep pace with a fast-moving industry and bring the good ideas back.

What you'll take away from this role

•

Deep, practical fluency across a wide range of global payment methods and channels — knowledge that is genuinely hard to acquire anywhere else

•

Experience designing and operating systems entrusted with substantial user assets, where correctness and recoverability are non-negotiable

•

A track record of shipping in a regulated, high-stakes domain at real scale

What We Look For In You

• 5+ years of backend software development experience, with a proven track record of building and operating high-availability, large-scale applications.

• Strong engineering fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and software design patterns — and the judgment to know when to reach for which.

• Ownership instinct. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tickets. When something's broken or unclear, you move toward it.

• Ability to drive cross-team collaboration, managing complex dependencies and competing requirements without losing momentum.

• Excellent problem-solving skills, and comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain a complex technical trade-off to an engineer and to a non-technical stakeholder, and land it with both.

• Genuine interest in crypto or fintech, and in building things that make money move better.

We’re looking for a Senior Systems Analyst, Enterprise Apps (Finance) to join our Enterprise Applications and Architecture team. The mission of our team is to drive automation through an integrated suite of enterprise systems and technologies, streamlining the business operations and freeing up our finance team’s time to focus on high-judgment tasks. In this role, you will serve as our financial systems subject matter expert primarily supporting Zip, Netsuite and other financial technologies. You will partner with our product managers and sourcing, legal, accounting, security team members to translate business requirements into technical solutions that can scale and support the growth of the company. You will join a small, agile and a tight-knit engineering team that is focussed on delivering value. We are seeking individuals who love problem solving and thrive in a continuous-learning and high level-of-ownership environment.

What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties): To be completed by all business teams except Eng.

• Partner with Product Managers and finance stakeholders to implement the product roadmap for Zip, Navan, NetSuite and other financial applications.

• Analyze current business processes, perform fit/gap analysis and translate the business requirements into technical solutions.

• Demonstrate knowledge of Zip’s capabilities for key processes: Source to Pay, Order to Cash, General Accounting and Financial Reporting.

• Perform platform administration, maintenance and support on a day to day basis for Zip and boundary systems.

• Create engineering artifacts - Functional and Technical Specifications, Data Flow Diagrams and Business Architecture Diagrams.

• Design and build scalable solutions in Zip and other applications, including customizations, workflows, integrations and analytics/reporting.

• Collaborate with citizen developers and engineers across multiple teams to develop and implement AI automations and agentic flows.

• Develop and execute test plans for identified features, lead integration and user acceptance testing with cross-functional teams.

• Participate in all engineering maturity activities (Agile, Observability, TechDebt Management, Automated Testing, Incident and Defect Management).

• Troubleshoot and fix production issues, prioritizing them against the existing backlog based on severity and impact.

• Support the business process transformation initiatives to improve efficiencies around critical activities like Month End Closure and Reporting.

• Conduct solution walkthroughs, application demos and user training sessions.

What we look for in you (ie. job requirements): To be completed by all business teams except Eng.

• 5+ years of system administration experience of Source to Pay systems like Zip,Coupa, NetSuite and other finance applications like Navan, Brex, Oracle.

• 4+ years of hands-on configuration experience of various Zip modules - Vendor Management, Sourcing Intake, Procurement, Payables, Payment, Taxes, Customizations (custom forms, fields, roles, queues), Workflows, AI Agents (native and custom agents) and Reporting.

• 3+ years of experience with large scale implementations of Sourcing/Procurement systems and their integrations through middleware technologies like Zip AppStudio/Workato/MulseSoft/Boomi.

• 1+ years of experience with AI technologies - designing, building and deploying slackbots and/or workflow-based agents using n8n and Workato Genie.

• Strong understanding of system-to-system integration principles, data flow patterns, and enterprise integration technologies, including web services, REST/SOAP APIs, file-based integrations, event-driven architectures, and MCP-based connectivity.

• Strong knowledge of finance related business processes such as Sourcing, Procurement, Payables, Vendor Management, Expenses and General Accounting.

• Deep understanding of month end accounting processes and financial statements/reporting features in Zip/NetSuite.

• Experience with Agile methodology - sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement and reporting in Jira.

• Knowledge of production Support, incident and defect management processes.

• Desire to continually learn new systems, wear multiple hats and act autonomously to support our growing finance functions.

• Clear communication and collaboration with cross-functional technical resources.

• NetSuite, Workato / Middleware experience.
